title: Console: marketplace onboarding wizard (org linking + entitlement status + error states)
author: Chloe Martin
description: Summary: Adds a first-pass Marketplace Onboarding wizard in Console to make purchase → entitlement activation → org linking more self-serve. The wizard (1) detects marketplace entitlements and their activation state, (2) guides users through linking an AWS/GCP marketplace purchase to a Redwood org, and (3) improves empty/error states to reduce Support escalations (wrong org, delayed entitlement, region mismatch). Motivation: Partner review feedback + Support tickets indicate buyers get stuck when entitlement activation is delayed or when they purchased under a different cloud account than expected. This PR makes entitlement state visible, adds actionable remediation steps, and improves error copy aligned with PMM/Security language. Scope: Console only (UI + API wiring + analytics events). No changes to webhook ingestion/mapping logic; those are in ENG-4401/4402 and related PRs. Key changes: - New entry point: Settings → Billing → Cloud Marketplace (and a banner on first login for marketplace buyers when we detect pending entitlements). - Wizard steps: 1) Select provider (AWS/GCP) 2) Verify entitlement status (Pending/Active/Not found) 3) Link purchase to org (choose org, confirm account/project identifiers, acknowledge billing) 4) Confirmation + next steps. - Entitlement status panel: shows provider, entitlement ID (redacted), SKU name, region, last sync time, and a “Refresh status” action (polls backend; respects rate limits). - Error/empty states: * Not found: copy explains common causes (wrong AWS account / wrong GCP project / wrong region) + link to docs + support CTA * Pending activation: shows expected delay window and recommends waiting + refresh + escalation path if > X minutes * Already linked: surfaces which org is linked and how to switch (admin-only) * Region mismatch: shows purchased region vs current Console region; CTA to switch region or contact support - Instrumentation: `marketplace_onboarding_viewed`, `marketplace_entitlement_refresh_clicked`, `marketplace_link_attempted`, `marketplace_link_succeeded`, `marketplace_link_failed` w/ error codes. - Feature flag: `console.marketplaceOnboardingWizard` (default off) + allowlist for partner-review accounts. Notes: - Error copy intentionally avoids over-claiming security/compliance. Language reviewed with SecEng (see comments). - Entitlement identifiers are partially masked in UI and are never written to client-side logs. - “Switch org link” action is gated to org admins and requires an explicit confirmation modal. Testing: - Unit tests for wizard reducer + step transitions - Storybook snapshots for each empty/error state - E2E test (Playwright) for happy path w/ stubbed entitlement fixture - Manual: verified behavior for delayed entitlement and region mismatch in staging. Follow-ups: - Hook up backend-provided ETA for entitlement activation once available (ENG-4401 exposes only last_seen_at today). - Add docs deep-linking once final URLs land (ENG-4404/4405). - Consider adding a lightweight “copy purchase metadata” button for Support debugging (needs Security sign-off).

conversation:
Ethan Park (review): The UI looks good, but can we ensure we’re not leaking raw entitlement IDs to the client? The API currently returns `entitlement_id` and `external_customer_id`. Please mask before rendering and avoid sending in analytics. Chloe Martin (author): Updated `EntitlementStatusPanel` to mask IDs (show last 6 chars only) and removed entitlement ID from analytics payload; analytics now uses `provider` + `sku_family` + `status` + `error_code` only.

Leila Farouk (review): Playwright test flakes on my machine because the refresh polling triggers while the test is transitioning steps. Can we make polling opt-in only when panel is visible? Chloe Martin (author): Changed polling to start only when status panel is mounted and to stop on step change/unmount. Also added `data-testid` hooks and made refresh action deterministic in tests.

Markus Klein (review): Error copy: can we add a clearer “what to collect before contacting Support” section? AEs/SEs will want account/project + SKU + timestamp. Chloe Martin (author): Added a small callout in the Support CTA with the exact fields to share (AWS account ID or GCP project number, approximate purchase time, SKU name). IDs are still masked in UI.

Elliot Price (review): For docs links, we don’t have final URLs yet. Suggest gating behind a config constant so we can update without code changes. Chloe Martin (author): Added `MARKETPLACE_DOCS_URL_AWS` and `_GCP` to console config with placeholder defaults. Will update once ENG-4404/4405 merge.

Marcus Lin (security review): Region mismatch screen currently implies data residency guarantees. Please soften wording and point to the security FAQ rather than making a claim in-console. Chloe Martin (author): Adjusted copy to: “Your purchase is associated with a different region than this org’s current region. Some features and availability vary by region.” and linked to “Learn more” (security FAQ) without asserting residency.

CI: First Playwright run failed with timeout on step 3; rerun passed after polling fix.

Approval: Ethan approved after masking change. Leila approved after test stabilization. Markus approved with copy updates. Marcus approved after copy tweak. Merged via squash.
release_notes: Console: Added a Marketplace onboarding wizard to link cloud marketplace purchases to Redwood orgs, show entitlement status, and provide clearer remediation steps for common errors (pending activation, wrong org, region mismatch). Feature-flagged (console.marketplaceOnboardingWizard).
